def test_dynamic_like_collect(self):
        try:
            # 初始化发现页操作类（传入self即可复用所有minium对象）
            find_page = FindPage(self)

            # 链式调用公共方法，逻辑清晰
            find_page.goto_find_page()

            # 需要判断是不是在推荐菜单
            menu_name = self.page.get_element(menu_active_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            menu_name_text = menu_name.text

            if menu_name_text != menu_dynamic_name:
                menu_list = self.page.get_elements(menu_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
                # 点击推荐
                for i in menu_list:
                    if i.text == menu_dynamic_name:
                        i.tap()
                        self.logger.info(f"已切换到 {i.text} 菜单")

            """点赞 like"""
            # 获取底部所有 icon
            icon_list = self.page.get_element(dynamic_comment_control_icon_list_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            # 获取底部 点赞 icon 和 数量
            like_list = icon_list.get_elements(dynamic_comment_control_icon_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)[0]
            # 获取底部 点赞 icon
            like_status = like_list.get_element(selector=dynamic_comment_control_icon_tag, max_timeout=max_timeout)

            # 先判断是否是 未点赞
            if like_status.attribute("src") == [dynamic_list_unlike_icon_src]:
                # 如果是未点赞 先点赞 like
                like_status.click()

                time.sleep(1)

                # 获取底部所有 icon
                new_icon_list = self.page.get_element(dynamic_comment_control_icon_list_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
                # 获取底部 点赞 icon 和 数量
                new_like_list = new_icon_list.get_elements(dynamic_comment_control_icon_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)[0]
                # 获取底部 点赞 icon
                new_like_status = new_like_list.get_element(selector=dynamic_comment_control_icon_tag, max_timeout=max_timeout)

                if new_like_status.attribute("src") == [dynamic_list_like_icon_src]:
                    self.logger.info(f"点击 {dynamic_list_unlike_icon_name} 成功")
                else:
                    self.logger.info(f"点击 {dynamic_list_unlike_icon_name} 失败")

                time.sleep(1)
            else:
                # 如果是已点赞 取消点赞
                like_status.click()

                time.sleep(1)

                # 获取底部所有 icon
                new_icon_list = self.page.get_element(dynamic_comment_control_icon_list_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
                # 获取底部 点赞 icon 和 数量
                new_like_list = new_icon_list.get_elements(dynamic_comment_control_icon_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)[0]
                # 获取底部 点赞 icon
                new_like_status = new_like_list.get_element(selector=dynamic_comment_control_icon_tag, max_timeout=max_timeout)

                if new_like_status.attribute("src") == [dynamic_list_unlike_icon_src]:
                    self.logger.info(f"点击 {dynamic_list_like_icon_name} 成功")
                else:
                    self.logger.info(f"点击 {dynamic_list_like_icon_name} 失败")

            timestamp = time.strftime("%H%M%S")
            self.capture(f"点赞+收藏后_{timestamp}", region=self.page)

            """收藏 collect"""
            # 获取底部所有 icon
            icon_list = self.page.get_element(dynamic_comment_control_icon_list_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            # 获取底部 点赞 icon 和 数量
            collect_list = icon_list.get_elements(dynamic_comment_control_icon_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)[2]
            # 获取底部 点赞 icon
            collect_status = collect_list.get_element(selector=dynamic_comment_control_icon_tag, max_timeout=max_timeout)

            # 先判断是否是 未收藏
            if collect_status.attribute("src") == [dynamic_list_uncollect_icon_src]:
                # 如果是未收藏 先收藏 collect
                collect_status.click()

                time.sleep(1)

                # 获取底部所有 icon
                icon_list = self.page.get_element(dynamic_comment_control_icon_list_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
                # 获取底部 点赞 icon 和 数量
                new_collect_list = icon_list.get_elements(dynamic_comment_control_icon_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)[2]
                # 获取底部 点赞 icon
                new_collect_status = new_collect_list.get_element(selector=dynamic_comment_control_icon_tag,
                                                          max_timeout=max_timeout)

                if new_collect_status.attribute("src") == [dynamic_list_collect_icon_src]:
                    self.logger.info(f"点击 {dynamic_list_uncollect_icon_name} 成功")
                else:
                    self.logger.info(f"点击 {dynamic_list_uncollect_icon_name} 失败")

                time.sleep(1)
            else:
                # 如果是已收藏 取消收藏
                collect_status.click()

                time.sleep(1)

                # 获取底部所有 icon
                icon_list = self.page.get_element(dynamic_comment_control_icon_list_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
                # 获取底部 点赞 icon 和 数量
                new_collect_list = icon_list.get_elements(dynamic_comment_control_icon_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)[2]
                # 获取底部 点赞 icon
                new_collect_status = new_collect_list.get_element(selector=dynamic_comment_control_icon_tag,
                                                          max_timeout=max_timeout)

                if new_collect_status.attribute("src") == [dynamic_list_uncollect_icon_src]:
                    self.logger.info(f"点击 {dynamic_list_collect_icon_name} 成功")
                else:
                    self.logger.info(f"点击 {dynamic_list_collect_icon_name} 失败")

            timestamp = time.strftime("%H%M%S")
            self.capture(f"点赞+收藏后_{timestamp}", region=self.page)

        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"点赞、收藏失败：{str(e)}")
            # 异常时截图
            timestamp = time.strftime("%H%M%S")
            self.capture(f"点赞、收藏失败_{timestamp}")
            raise

        time.sleep(2)
